content: Chloroxylenol is an antibacterial agent that has been approved by the FDA for use in handwashing to reduce bacteria on the skin. Common adverse reactions associated with its use include irritation and redness. Adult Indications and Dosage For FDA-labeled indications in adults: Wet hands and forearms. Apply 5 milliliters (approximately a teaspoonful or palmful) to the hands and forearms. Scrub thoroughly for 1 minute and rinse. For off-label use in adults: There is limited information available regarding guideline-supported or non-guideline-supported off-label uses of sodium oxybate in adult patients. For off-label use in pediatric patients: There is limited information available regarding guideline-supported or non-guideline-supported off-label uses of sodium oxybate in pediatric patients. Contraindications There is limited information available regarding contraindications for chloroxylenol in the drug label. Warnings This product is for external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes. In case of eye contact, flush the eyes with water. Discontinue use and consult a doctor if irritation or redness develops, or if the condition persists for more than 72 hours. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
